newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Hang Seng index crosses 14,000 points.
newsitem.headline: HK's Hang Seng index crosses 14,000 points.

text.p: Hong Kong's Hang Seng index crossed the 14,000 point level for the first time on Thursday afternoon, rising 238.28 points to an all-time high of 14,004.93.
The index later pulled back to trade up 216.53 points, or 1.57 percent, at 13,983.18
Turnover was a hefty HK$11.19 billion.

"Utilities and conglomerates are the two major groups which have led the rally today," said Alex Tang, head of research at Yamaichi International. "These two are market laggards. We are seeing some rotational buying now," he said.
A surge in banking and property stocks led the Hang Seng index's 472.78 point gain on Wednesday.
Wheelock was up HK$1.30 at HK$22.60, CITIC Pacific rose HK$1.10 to HK$41.70 and Swire Pacific gained HK$1.00 to HK$73.50.
